name: Clearskies Cowork Plugin
description: Clearskies connects Salesforce, Gong, Scratchpad, Google, Microsoft, and Slack into a Customer Context Graph — a live, unified view of every account — then exposes it to Claude via MCP. The Cowork plugin puts that on top of six native GTM workflows: account briefs, deal risk scoring, call prep, post-call summaries, pipeline review, and personalized outreach. Works standalone; supercharged when connected to your GTM stack.
longDescription:
Ships **4 skills** and **13 commands**.

- **Skills** (4): `skill-account-research` (Research a company or contact using the Clearskies Customer Context Graph — pulling unified context from CRM, calls,…), `skill-churn-risk` (Churn risk awareness — auto-triggers when discussing existing customers, renewals, customer health, or account reviews), `skill-customer-context-graph` (Understand and explain the Clearskies Customer Context Graph — what it is, what data it contains, and how…), `skill-qbr-prep` (QBR preparation knowledge — auto-triggers when a user mentions a quarterly review, QBR, business review, or preparing for…)
- **Commands** (13): `account-brief` (Generate a full account brief from the Customer Context Graph — CRM, calls, email, calendar, and Slack in…), `call-prep` (Prepare a complete pre-call brief — account snapshot, last call summary, open items, contact context, suggested agenda, and…), `churn-risk` (Identify customers at risk of churning — surface engagement drops, unresolved issues, renewal proximity, and relationship health signals…), `daily-brief` (Start your day with a prioritized sales leadership briefing — what closed, what's at risk, what's on the…), `deal-review` (Audit every risk signal in a deal before it costs you the close — champion engagement, economic buyer…), `deal-strategy` (Think through a stuck or complex deal from first principles — identify the real move, the real buyer,…), `draft-outreach` (Draft signal-grounded outreach for a contact using Customer Context Graph data), `meddic` (Run a MEDDIC qualification audit grounded in real signals — calls, emails, CRM, Slack), and 5 more

Installs with `claude plugin install clearskies-cowork-plugin@claude-community` from `scratchpad-ai/clearskies-cowork-plugin` (`plugins/clearskies`).
